_doku: Share-count hand table (Tag 1397, W2 2026-10-02). Read by lib/ads-hand-table.js at both marketCap write sites of pull-yahoo.js, after the ADS table.
Row = a USD line whose Yahoo marketCap uses a wrong share count. implied = Yahoo marketCap / quote price.
implied within 3 % of shares: confirmed, untouched. Within 3 % of a wrongShares entry: marketCap = price x shares, stamped 'hand-table:shares', derived Yahoo fields blanked.
Anything else: Yahoo value kept, meta._shareCountHandTableStale stamped, ::warning:: in the pull log, price-only refused - re-verify, then fix or remove the row.

Admission: issuer filing quote for the count (url, quote, unit shares) and the wrong count read from a stored vendor snapshot. Corrected values below the pull's MIN_MCAP floor leave the universe like any other small line.

reviewBy: latest due date of the next periodic filing (10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-09-30: 45 days, next business day). A row cannot see new issuance by itself: once the marketCap data day is past reviewBy, the pull raises ::warning:: every run and still applies the row, until the count is re-verified and reviewBy moved.

P205: withholdUnverified rows require validFrom, a German reason and proven USD quotes. Unknown or overdue values are withheld with a warning on expiry. _holds contains source-backed cases without a reproducible replacement; it also requires reviewBy. lib/market-cap-guard.js applies only these explicitly marked rows before the legacy share-count applier.
